text.p: Polish bankers expect year-on-year inflation in December to ease to 19.4 percent from 19.5 percent in October, a poll by the private Pentor institute showed.
November inflation data are not yet available.
Last month the bankers expected inflation to end the year at 19.5 percent.
The 211 bank managers polled by Pentor in December expected inflation at the end of next year to fall to 16.6 percent.
The government sees inflation ending this year at around 18 percent and at 13 percent next year.
The bankers also expected the dollar to end the year at 2.87 zlotys, up from its current 2.86 but the same as the bankers forecast last month.
They also predicted the dollar would end next year at three zlotys, an average of forecasts that fell between 2.86 zlotys and 3.11 zlotys.
The Pentor survey is commissioned monthly by the Polish Banking Association (ZBP).
